title: Home's kept test runs say their people are a script, so their acts never become a person's label
request: The owner: continue non-stop; collect every test's data for the six models. Before writing more Home journeys (36.3), check how the store keeps a scripted run apart.
spec: keepers.workspaces.scripted: a folder with scripted.json at or above it is a script's; decisions.build sets its person labels aside. Home's eval runs and its tools probe kept their drafts and ledgers without that file.
plan: Check which kept Home runs carry scripted.json
One helper writes it; the eval run and the probe call it

decisions.decision: The marker is written at the top of the kept run, and by observe() when its caller's folder has none
decisions.why: scripted() walks up the folders; one file covers every case's workspace, and a direct caller of observe() is covered too

decisions.decision: The runs kept before the fix are marked by hand
decisions.why: their labels were already in the store as a person's; the next build sets them aside

decisions.decision: The orchestrator run of 2026-10-21 is left unmarked
decisions.why: it was not checked here whether a person drove it; marking it would hide a real label if one is there

change: the Home eval package (agent_eval.home) (mark_scripted; measure and observe call it), its tools probe (agent_eval.home.tools_probe) (calls it), tests/test_home_eval.py; scripted.json added by hand to the Home test folders kept on 2026-10-27 and 2026-10-28 (not in git).

findings.defect: A kept Home test run's script acts were read as a person's labels
findings.scenario: the tools probe picks the kind of help itself (choose_intent), which writes a user_decision_exposed label on request.intent; the eval arms answer questions the same way; none of the four kept Home folders had scripted.json
findings.cause: the runners kept a workspace layout (drafts/ and ledger/) so the store would collect them, but never said a script drove them
findings.fix: mark_scripted writes scripted.json at the kept run's top; the four folders already kept were marked

measurements.name: Kept Home test workspaces the store sees as scripted
measurements.gate: every kept Home eval and probe workspace
measurements.result: 65 (28 from 2026-10-27, 35 from the 2026-10-28 eval, 2 from the tools probe); the home-model folder holds logs only

outcome: Home's test runs still reach the store whole, but a script's choices are no longer mistaken for a person's verdict.
lessons: Keeping a test's data for training needs two things: the data, and a mark of who made its choices.
risks: The store's sets built before the next store build still hold those labels as a person's.
The 2026-10-21 orchestrator run was not checked.
